subject: Next steps: procurement path & hosting alignment for Brightline PoC
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Angela Park <angela.park@brightlinehealth.com>, Tom Li <tom.li@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Brightline PoC discovery — procurement & hosting checklist

Hi Angela / Tom —

Thanks again for a productive call today. Quick recap and the items we need to move procurement forward for the PoC: 

1) Purchasing path preference — card (credit) vs PO? If PO, any internal approval gates (legal/finance signoffs) and estimated lead time?
2) Marketplace interest — are you evaluating AWS Marketplace or a corporate procurement portal? If yes, we can share an AMI/marketplace SKU and pricing mapping.
3) Hosting fit — primary path question: do you want Redwood Hosted (fastest launch), Dedicated reserved capacity (predictable throughput & SLA), or Private VPC/on-prem (regulatory requirement)? We can size PoC on Hosted and move to Dedicated if you need commit pricing.
4) Payment terms — standard is net30 for PO; hosted on-demand via card billed monthly; dedicated has monthly commit options.
5) Compliance docs — attached DPA & SOC2 summary; let us know if you need vendor questionnaires or additional evidence.

Next steps I propose: 
- Tom: confirm buying path (PO vs card) and whether AWS Marketplace is required by 9/17.
- Angela / Technical team: confirm whether Hosted PoC is acceptable for initial evaluation or if Private/Dedicated is mandatory.
- Karthik & I will prepare a short pricing options grid (on-demand vs 3/6/12 month commits, hosted vs dedicated vs private) and a one-page procurement checklist.

I attached a working pricing summary and the procurement form to help your finance team. Happy to jump on a 20-min call with Tom and procurement to walk through the PO form if helpful.

Thanks,

Rachel Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

Attachments: redwood-pricing-summary-v2.pdf (1 page), dpa-redwood-2026.pdf (DPA), brightline-procurement-form.xlsx (blank)
From: Tom Li <tom.li@brightlinehealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Angela Park <angela.park@brightlinehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Brightline PoC discovery — procurement & hosting checklist

Thanks, Rachel — good notes. Quick answers from finance side: 

- We prefer to use a PO for anything > $10k; card for small pilots < $2k would be faster but needs approvals from IT procurement. For the PoC we're targeting $7-10k range estimates depending on token usage.
- Marketplace: would prefer AWS Marketplace if possible (helps internal approval and billing). Is there a mapping between your SKU/pricing and the marketplace SKU?
- Payment terms: if we go PO, standard is net45 on our side (we'll check if finance can do net30 for vendors in our AI program).

Also attached is our internal procurement form (filled partially) — you'll see the fields we need populated (tax ID, legal name, invoice remit address, terms).

Can Karthik or Rachel prepare the pricing grid showing: Hosted on-demand (per-token), Hosted with 3-month commit (discount %), Dedicated (monthly reserved GPU) with commit levels, and an estimate for Private/VPC (one-time onboarding + monthly infra fee)? That will help our procurement and finance team decide.

Tom Li
Sr. Manager, Finance Ops | Brightline Health
tom.li@brightlinehealth.com
Attachment: brightline-procurement-form-filled.xlsx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Li <tom.li@brightlinehealth.com>, Angela Park <angela.park@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 15:47:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Brightline PoC discovery — procurement & hosting checklist

Tom / Angela —

Appreciate the details. A few clarifications and what we'll deliver by EOD tomorrow: 

Clarifications: 
- AWS Marketplace: yes, we can map the Marketplace SKU to our hosted pricing; the marketplace listing supports subscription and metered billing. Note marketplace pricing may differ slightly due to marketplace fees — we'll show both values.
- PO vs card: if your final chosen path is PO + net45 we can accommodate but that will typically require Sales Ops/Legal signature and a short SOW for the PoC.
- PoC sizing: for hosted on-demand estimates we'll assume 100k tokens/month as a baseline demo usage (we can adjust if you expect higher).

Deliverables (by 2026-09-16 EOD PST): 
1) Pricing grid: hosted on-demand per-token, hosted commit tiers (3/6/12 months), dedicated reserved options (monthly committed GPUs + throughput), private deployment estimate (onboarding fee + monthly infra).
2) Marketplace mapping: SKU + approximate marketplace price and billing notes.
3) Completed procurement form (we'll fill vendor/legal fields) and a short checklist of required approvals and average lead times for PO processing.

If Tom can confirm the internal PO routing contacts (name/email) we can include them on the procurement call. I'll also include a short note on discount thresholds for commit levels.

Karthik Iyer
Principal Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0123
From: Angela Park <angela.park@brightlinehealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Tom Li <tom.li@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Brightline PoC discovery — procurement & hosting checklist

Perfect — thanks for the fast turnaround. A couple of final notes from the product team: Hosted is fine for the initial PoC (data is non-sensitive for the demo); we will plan for AWS Marketplace if the pricing aligns. Tom — I'll loop in our procurement contact (Sana Ahmed, sana.ahmed@brightlinehealth.com) on the follow-up call.

Next steps: 
- Karthik/Rachel: share the pricing grid and completed procurement form (tom/finance and sana) by EOD 9/16.
- Marissa: please add a short paragraph on onboarding timeline and who from Redwood will own the PoC run.
- Tom/Sana: scheduling a 20-min call to confirm PO routing — propose 9/17 10am PT or 9/20 9am PT.

Looking forward —

Angela Park
Director, Product Strategy | Brightline Health
angela.park@brightlinehealth.com
